availability.module.name: Availability
availability.module.description: Members say when they are free, maybe or busy, with a weekly pattern and dated exceptions. People who plan for a team see it in one place, and can ask the team to check theirs.
availability.settings.grid.step.label: Time step
availability.settings.grid.step.help: The smallest piece of time people mark on their availability. Times start and end on this step.
availability.settings.entry.unmarked-def: What a person's unmarked time means, unless they choose for themselves. "Not known" asks planners to check; "Free" assumes they can come.
availability.settings.entry.horizon.help: The furthest ahead anyone can enter a dated change to their availability.
availability.abilities.find.anyone.label: See anyone's availability
availability.abilities.request.send.labe: Ask people to check their availability
availability.navigation.mine.label: My availability
availability.settings.grid.day-starts.he: The first time shown on the availability grid before scrolling.
availability.settings.grid.day-ends.help: The last time shown on the availability grid before scrolling.
availability.grid.label: Your availability, a row for each time and a column for each day
availability.grid.now-the-end: Now choose where it ends, on the same day.
availability.mine.title: My availability
availability.mine.description: Show when you are free, maybe or busy, so people planning rehearsals and meetings can find a time that suits you.
availability.mine.how: Choose Free, Maybe, Busy or Clear, then drag down a day, or tap where it starts and then where it ends. Tap a day's name to paint all of it. Clear takes back what you painted.
availability.mine.asked-help: Mark the times you cannot do, then press "This is right". Press it even if nothing has changed.
availability.mine.asked-done: You have said this is right. You can still change your availability.
availability.mine.entries-help: Changes for particular dates, newest winning where they overlap. They come before your weekly pattern.
availability.mine.which-title: Just these days, or every week?
availability.mine.which-help: This day follows your "{pattern}" pattern. Change just this day, or the pattern for every week it covers? We will remember your answer while you are on this page.
availability.entry.title: Add a change
availability.entry.description: For particular dates: away, exams, or free after all.
availability.entry.dates-needed: Choose the first and last day.
availability.entry.some-days: Only on some days of the week
availability.entry.until-after: The end must be after the start.
availability.entry.reason-help: Only you see it, unless you share it below.
availability.entry.share: Share the reason with people who plan for me
availability.entry.share-help: Only people planning for a group you are in, such as your production's team, will see it.
